records.title: Second-Year Czech
records.text: CZECH 404 Second-Year Czech (5) A&H Continuation of CZECH 401, CZECH 402, CZECH 403. Selected readings from the main works of Czech authors of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries. Reinforces and extends basic knowledge of Czech grammar and vocabulary. First in a sequence of three. Prerequisite: minimum grade of 2.0 in CZECH 403. Offered: A.

records.title: Modern Czech Literature in English
records.header: CZECH 420 Modern Czech Literature in English (5) A&H
records.text: CZECH 420 Modern Czech Literature in English (5) A&H Representative works of Czech literature from the 1920s to the present in the context of earlier Czech and general European literary trends. Emphasis on prose and drama of major writers, including Hasek, Capek, Vancura, Skvorecky, Kundera, Vaculik, and Havel.
